propositions: Each fallback candidate must emit exactly one OTel span ordered zero-based with no duplication from instrument_all, nesting as a child under the single Agent model-request span via ambient context

Every candidate span must carry provider-qualified model identity, outcome drawn only from {returned, raised}, and provider-reported usage when exposed by the SDK, with error text sanitized through sanitize_diagnostic

The bug-895c native-to-prompted fallback must remain observable as two distinct Agent-request spans (native raised, prompted returned) with zero change to _pai_structured control flow and no addition to UsageLimits or JSONL usage counters
Candidate wrapping and span emission errors must be swallowed at the wrapper boundary so that fallback result, RunUsage, and propagated exception remain identical regardless of tracing state
The existing ordered FallbackExceptionGroup resolution and classification must remain unchanged by instrumentation; FallbackModel selection and ProviderSession lifecycle must not be altered
Base install without tracing extra imports must execute with no span dependency error and produce identical results
